title: Line sketch: Bubbles and Martinis
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A man in a white suit raises a martini glass toward two elegant women seated inside a large transparent bubble chair. The composition positions the man in the lower left looking upward while the bubble and women dominate the upper right against a solid background. Clean lines, flat vibrant colors, and stylized forms define the mid-century illustration technique (derived from painting #159).
